title: HCP Events (oncology franchise, South India)
summary: Four roles including an external HCP login and a Compliance Head, approved venues, advisory boards, CMEs and congresses with compliance approval, RSVP with travel and stay needs, QR attendance per session, advisory outputs gating honoraria, a spend ledger tied to recipient HCPs, quarterly disclosure reports with maker-checker sign-off, and Event and HCP 360 pages.
